content.user_title: Write Forceful Prose Without AI Tics
content.value_statement: Generic AI writing can feel padded and predictable. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward concise, vivid prose with stronger sentence control.
actual_capabilities: Guides generation toward hard-edged, forceful English prose.
Reduces common AI writing tics in drafts and revisions.
Applies a style contract to requested writing tasks.
Helps rewrite existing text with concise, direct language.
Supports prose tone adjustments for essays, posts, and product copy.
limitations: Contains guidance only, with no scripts or automated checks.
Does not verify factual accuracy or citations.
Does not define detailed grammar rules or publication standards.
Strong style may not fit formal, academic, or regulated writing.

use_cases.title: Editorial Draft Cleanup
use_cases.description: Revise rough copy into clearer prose with fewer filler phrases and stronger sentences.

use_cases.title: Founder Message Revision
use_cases.description: Sharpen announcements, essays, and internal notes without making them sound generic.

use_cases.title: Technical Narrative Polish
use_cases.description: Improve developer-facing explanations while keeping the original facts and structure intact.

prompt_templates.title: Polish a Short Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this paragraph with clear, forceful prose. Remove filler and common AI phrases. Keep my meaning intact: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Shape a Professional Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise this note in the beautiful-prose style. Make it direct, specific, and calm. Keep the audience and purpose unchanged: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Revise an Essay Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this section for sharper rhythm and stronger sentence control. Preserve facts and citations. Return a polished version plus three brief revision notes: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Create a Style Pass
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced final pass for a full draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the beautiful-prose style contract to this full draft. Strengthen diction, vary sentence length, and remove generic phrasing. Mark any places where the source meaning is unclear: [paste text]

output_examples.input: Please make this product update sound less generic.
output_examples.output: A tighter announcement with direct claims, fewer stock phrases, and clearer stakes for the reader.

output_examples.input: Edit this essay opening for stronger prose.
output_examples.output: A revised opening that cuts filler, varies sentence length, and keeps the original argument visible.

output_examples.input: Review this technical explanation for style.
output_examples.output: A polished explanation with plain verbs, cleaner transitions, and brief notes on unclear source meaning.

best_practices: Provide the audience, purpose, and desired level of intensity.
Ask the model to preserve facts, names, and citations.
Review the final draft for accuracy before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not use it to hide weak evidence or unsupported claims.
Do not ask for a dramatic tone when precision matters more.
Do not apply the style blindly to legal or compliance text.

faq.question: Does this skill write new content from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide new prose, but it works best when you provide purpose and audience.

faq.question: Can it edit existing drafts?
faq.answer: Yes. It can revise pasted text for clarity, rhythm, and fewer AI-like phrases.

faq.question: Does it check facts?
faq.answer: No. It changes style and wording, so users must verify factual accuracy separately.

faq.question: Is it suitable for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it run code or access files?
faq.answer: No. The skill is prompt-only guidance and contains no executable scripts.

faq.question: What writing style does it encourage?
faq.answer: It encourages direct, forceful English prose with fewer generic AI writing habits.
